title: Keep specimen intake, processing, derived task queue and execution distinct
summary: Keep specimen intake, authorized specimen analysis, any resulting downstream task queue, and execution of those tasks as independent, explicitly authorized workflows with distinct states and traceable transitions.
statement: Keep specimen intake, authorized specimen analysis, any resulting downstream task queue, and execution of those tasks as independent, explicitly authorized workflows with distinct states and traceable transitions.
rationale: Normalized public-safe rule proposal from an explicitly authorized specimen analysis.

conditions: Derived tasks do not exist automatically merely because analysis finishes.

authority.source: Published in Nomos by explicit batch authorization; general guidance, never automatically applied

provenance.notes: Public-safe normalized candidate; source conversation is not reproduced. Catalog decision recorded in downstream processing tasks; not automatically applicable to any project. Generalizes existing independent workflow discipline without changing the constitution.
